posts.author: Slasher
posts.title: Server is boring.
posts.html:
I have been playing on VM for 2 1/2 weeks now, and after this update today, everything is boring.  In the beginning, there was so much action, so much intensity.  Even though there was a LOT of RDM, it was fun to me and other people to constantly be on guard and raid the mayor.  Now, with 80k for 10 usps, and all of our inv's wiped, there is nothing fun to do.  You can't raid unless you are rolling in cash, you cant kill anybody without them yelling at you to be banned.  Is it just me or do salaries take longer to come?  Also, the god damn price inflation.  It is almost a joke at how high prices are now, everyone is leaving mostly because of this for any other reason.  I have many friends that were about to donate to the server before the update, but now they think it is boring and are playing on PERP or Darkland.  I am not making this topic to flame the admins or scripters,  I made this solely for the purpose of expressing my general view on this new update. 

So far here are the ratings:

Entertainment: 4/10

I understand that you wanted to stop the RDM, and the violence on the server.  But all you got out of it was a dull RP world that many people are leaving.  I am leaving.  C ya.

Playability:7/10
